Five sites still assert the RETIRED narrow claim ('exact up to escaped processes') and sit outside every current ticket's allowed globs:
- README.md:59 — the most user-facing surviving instance; tracked by nobody.
- docs/adoption.md:26 and :387-390
- .spec/specs/package.spec.md:29 — SHARPEST: the subject summary asserts docs/coverage.md carries the 'exact up to escaped processes' claim, and after dn4.6 that file verifiably says 'exact within disclosed chained windows' (docs/coverage.md:100, :153). This is a spec asserting something false about a file the epic changed.

NOT in this ticket: lib/specled_ex/coverage/formatter.ex:12's moduledoc — handed to specled_-dn4.9 (directive posted on that ticket), because dn4.9 owns formatter.ex and merges last.

Allowed touches: README.md, docs/adoption.md, .spec/specs/package.spec.md, CHANGELOG.md.
Out of Scope (files): all of lib/**, all test/**, every other .spec/specs/*, docs/coverage.md (dn4.6 owns it), docs/concepts.md.
Out of Scope (intent): do not restate the bound in your own words — reuse the exact wording dn4.6 landed in .spec/decisions/specled.decision.per_test_sync_boundary.md and docs/coverage.md so the corpus stays consistent. Do not rename any requirement id. Do not weaken package.spec.md's requirement to dodge the false assertion — fix the assertion.

Advances: specled.package (package.spec.md). Verify the doc-identifier lint still passes.
Verification: mix spec.validate; mix spec.check --no-run-commands; bare mix spec.check; mix test test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs; mix format --check-formatted; plus a repo-wide grep proving zero surviving 'exact up to escaped processes' outside the ADR's own history prose and the intentionally-unrenamed requirement id.

DISJOINT: none of these files are touched by dn4.5, dn4.6, dn4.7, or dn4.9 — this ticket carries no dependency and may run in parallel with the remaining chain.

## Mechanical checks

Scope (git diff 016bf12..HEAD --name-only), single commit 39e3575, worktree clean:
- .spec/specs/package.spec.md (+1/-1), CHANGELOG.md (+8/-4), README.md (+1/-1), docs/adoption.md (+10/-5). All four inside Allowed touches.
- Out of Scope untouched, confirmed by the same name-only list: zero lib/**, zero test/**, zero other .spec/specs/*, no docs/coverage.md, no docs/concepts.md.

CHANGELOG legitimacy (the item flagged for scrutiny): genuine, and stronger than "plausible". `diff CHANGELOG.md` against dn4.6's worktree copy is byte-identical — the whole file, not just the hunks. Both hunks are retired-wording repairs to the already-authored 0.7.0 entry: the lead bullet's "now exact" -> "now exact within disclosed chained windows" plus the chained-[head, tail] disclosure, and the per-subject card qualifier "(exact up to escaped processes)" -> "(exact within chained windows)". That second string is the literal label dn4.6 landed in review/html.ex:2038/3159. No new release notes, no version bump, no unrelated bullets.

Gates (all from the stage worktree):
- mix compile --warnings-as-errors: clean
- mix format --check-formatted: clean
- mix deps.unlock --check-unused: clean
- mix spec.validate: status=pass errors=0 warnings=1
- mix spec.check --no-run-commands: status=pass errors=0 warnings=0; findings=47, one WARNING (append_only/same_pr_self_authorization on specled.decision.coverage_qualifier_requirement_ids). Pre-existing at base — that ADR entered the tree in 91987f7 (specled_-dn4.8), which is an ancestor of base 016bf12. Not introduced by dn4.11.
- bare mix spec.check: status=pass errors=0 warnings=0, 134s wall (vs 2.3s for --no-run-commands), so the execute:true commands genuinely ran.
- mix test test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs: 7 tests, 0 failures
- mix test (full, not required but cheap): 3 properties, 1211 tests, 0 failures. The specled_-zr6 tracer_test.exs:241 StreamData flake did not fire (seed 380969); no re-run needed.

Note on branch-guard base: `git fetch` fails in this worktree (the known SSH-push/fetch breakage), so origin/main is the local 6fe5b77. Base 016bf12 does not descend from it, which is why changed_files=77 and impacted_subjects lists 27 subjects — that is epic-stage accumulation, not dn4.11's diff.

## Semantic checks

WORDING CONSISTENCY — reuse, not paraphrase. Verified against dn4.6's worktree read-only (nothing written there).
- docs/adoption.md:387-395, the big one: word-diffed against dn4.6's docs/coverage.md:153-164. The body is verbatim, character for character, from "The first hooked test takes an initial head snapshot" through "Neither source of leakage is detected at runtime." The only deltas are (a) the lead-in reframed from coverage.md's "**Hooked tests: exact within chained windows.**" to adoption.md's existing "**Claim.** Hooked tests are **exact within chained windows**." — a grammatical adaptation to the section's own convention, which the pre-edit text also used, and (b) the trailing "See `specled.decision.per_test_sync_boundary`." is dropped. Neither changes the claim. The dropped ADR pointer is not a regression: the retired text carried no ADR reference either, and adoption.md:384 already deep-links coverage.md's wiring section.
- README.md:59 and docs/adoption.md:26: both now read "exact within disclosed chained windows", which is the exact phrase from coverage.md's section heading at :100 ("## `--per-test`: opt-in, exact within disclosed chained windows") and from the ADR's "exact within the disclosed chained window". Both are drop-in substitutions into the pre-existing sentence frames; no surrounding prose was rewritten.
- CHANGELOG card qualifier "exact within chained windows" matches html.ex's landed label exactly.
No divergent paraphrase anywhere. Judgment: reuse bar met.

THE package.spec.md:29 SUBTLETY. Answering the four parts explicitly.
(a) What it now asserts: "Docs include coverage capture (docs/coverage.md), including the per-test boundary-hook wiring subsection and Stage-2 auditor/unhooked-degrade claim (exact within disclosed chained windows)." Three claims about docs/coverage.md's content — the wiring subsection exists, the Stage-2 auditor/unhooked-degrade claim exists, and that claim is phrased "exact within disclosed chained windows". The summary was NOT rewritten to avoid file-specific assertion; it still asserts file-specific content, just updated content.
(b) False on this branch in isolation? Yes, in its third clause. On 39e3575, docs/coverage.md:100 still reads "opt-in, exact up to escaped processes" and :153 "**Hooked tests: exact up to escaped processes.**". The first two clauses stay true. So the branch currently carries a subject summary asserting wording its own tree does not contain — the same class of defect dn4.11 was created to remove, transiently inverted.
(c) Detectable by any gate? No. Demonstrated, not assumed: spec.validate, spec.check --no-run-commands and bare spec.check all pass green on this exact tree with the mismatch present. A spec-meta `summary` is free prose; nothing cross-checks it against the content of files listed in `surface:`. package.doc_identifier_integrity lints finding codes and bare-token severity values, not claim prose, and docs_identifier_lint_test passes. Realization-drift hashes surfaces but does not parse summaries. Human review is the only detector.
(d) Is the merge-order dependency sufficient? For the epic branch, yes. With dn4.6 blocking dn4.11 the integration branch never observes the summary ahead of the file: docs/coverage.md carries the chained-window wording before 39e3575 lands, and both branches' package.spec.md edits are disjoint (dn4.6 touches only the verification block around :118, leaving :29 at the retired wording — confirmed by grepping its worktree; dn4.11 touches only :29), so the merge is content-clean, not just conflict-clean. Not sufficient for this stage branch observed alone, which is exactly the state above and which no gate reports. Residual risk worth naming for the orchestrator: if dn4.6 is dropped, re-scoped, or re-words the claim before merging, this summary becomes permanently false and nothing in the toolchain will say so. Given docs/coverage.md is Out of Scope here and the ticket explicitly forbade weakening the requirement to dodge the assertion, this is the correct resolution, not a defect. Recording it as a Note.

RETIRED-WORDING SWEEP. Repo-wide grep for the literal "exact up to escaped processes" on this branch (excluding _build/deps/.git) returns 30 lines. I re-derived every owner rather than trusting the IMPLEMENTED list, by running the same grep inside dn4.6's worktree: there, only 5 survive — README.md:59, docs/adoption.md:26, docs/adoption.md:387, .spec/specs/package.spec.md:29 (all four now fixed here) and lib/specled_ex/coverage/formatter.ex:12 (specled_-dn4.9 by directive). Everything else — docs/coverage.md:100/:153, the ADR heading at :77, review/html.ex (11 lines), review/coverage_closure.ex:209, review/html_test.exs (7 lines), and .spec/specs/coverage_capture.spec.md:29/:343 and spec_review.spec.md:274/:325/:716/:718/:749 — is already zero on dn4.6's branch, so dn4.6 owns all of it. Zero orphans. Separately, the requirement id specled.spec_review.coverage_exact_up_to_escaped_processes_qualifier survives at 13 sites and is deliberately unrenamed per its own ADR.
Correction to the IMPLEMENTED comment's sweep: its ~30-line list omitted 8 real survivors — .spec/specs/coverage_capture.spec.md:29 and :343, .spec/specs/spec_review.spec.md:274, :325, :716, :718, :749, and the ADR heading at :77. All eight are dn4.6's, so the conclusion ("no unowned survivor") holds, but the posted sweep was not complete as written.

REQUIREMENTS COVERAGE (Advances: specled.package).
- specled.package.adoption_guide (must). Evidence: the execute:true grep-chain command in package.spec.md's verification block, run under bare mix spec.check and independently by hand — 9/9 strings present. The nine it asserts: "## Greenfield", "## Brownfield", "Same as greenfield step 6: graduate", "enforcement: error", "guardrails:", "branch_guard:", "### Phase 4a — Aggregate coverage (zero wiring)", "### Phase 4b — Per-test attribution (opt-in)", "setup {SpecLedEx.Coverage, :per_test_boundary}". dn4.11's two adoption.md hunks land at :26-28 and :387-395; the asserted strings live at :64, :192, :194, :200, :210, :316, :357, :367 and :428 — no hunk overlaps one. Would-fail-if: I proved the chain is live by mutating a scratch copy of adoption.md to downcase the Phase 4b heading — the chain exits non-zero. So if the :387 rewrite had disturbed the Phase 4b heading or the setup line at :367, bare mix spec.check would have failed this command.
- specled.package.doc_identifier_integrity (must). Evidence: mix test test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs, 7 tests 0 failures, plus the tagged_tests verification that covers it under bare spec.check. Would-fail-if: had the new prose introduced a finding-code token not defined by the implementation, or a quoted severity value instead of a bare YAML token, the lint would fail. The rewrite introduces no codes and no severity values.
- The subject summary at :29 supports no requirement id directly — it is spec-meta prose describing the subject and its docs/coverage.md surface member. Its correctness is enforced only by review, which is item (c) above. Would-fail-if: nothing; that is the finding.
No must requirement is left uncovered by this diff, and none was weakened. No requirement id was renamed.

## Verdict

PASS. Scope is exact, the four sites reuse dn4.6's landed wording rather than paraphrasing it, the CHANGELOG co-change is a byte-identical copy of dn4.6's and not release-note authoring, every retired-wording survivor has a named owner, all seven gates plus the full suite are green, and the one genuinely uncomfortable property — package.spec.md:29 asserting content docs/coverage.md does not yet carry on this branch — is the resolution the ticket asked for and is fully mitigated by the dn4.6 -> dn4.11 merge order.

## Notes

1. Process defect on this ticket's record, as flagged: the IMPLEMENTED comment posted with a literal unexpanded $(agent-session lines --ticket specled_-dn4.11) and therefore no Session:/Log:, because a quoted heredoc suppressed command substitution. This comment's own attribution was produced by running `agent-session lines` and pasting the literal output.
2. Merge-order dependency is load-bearing and must not be relaxed. See item (d): the stage branch in isolation carries a false subject summary that no gate detects.
3. The IMPLEMENTED sweep list is incomplete by 8 lines (all dn4.6-owned). Conclusion unaffected; noting it because a future reader treating that list as the authoritative inventory would under-count what dn4.6 must fix.
4. The append_only/same_pr_self_authorization WARNING surfaced by spec.check is inherited from dn4.8 at base 016bf12, not from this ticket. It is a warning, not an error, and will need a review decision at epic-merge time.
5. Ticket left open. Nothing fixed, nothing written to dn4.6's worktree.
